title: FAST_TDA analytic two-photon gradient
summary: Evaluate a complete Cartesian derivative of the TDA two-photon tensor and isotropic strength with AO dipole, Pulay, orbital, SCC and selected-root response.
gates: the selected configuration space is frozen at the reference geometry
AO dipole and Pulay derivatives are analytic
orbital and SCC relaxation use the resident coupled response
target-root and three shifted response derivatives satisfy their residual gates
the Cartesian strength gradient passes translation invariance
a reconverged central difference is retained as a qualification oracle only
coordinate_policy: The atom order and Cartesian frame are immutable; a later property transformation may project the completed Cartesian gradient to SYCART or SONIC.
backend_policy: FAST_TDA and MATRIX-GFN2 are resident and no external executable participates in production evaluation.
